# Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state. [...] Despite the decline, Trump continues to have a net-positive approval rating among Alabama voters.

The latest figure shows a 6-point gap between approval and disapproval.
